title: Fisherman's Landing
specs: Targets species including Yellowtail, Bonito, Barracuda, Calico Bass, Tuna, Dorado, and more
Uses high performance 2025 36 foot Yellowfin Center Console for offshore trips
California fishing license required and rentals extra for local trips
Mexican fishing permits required for some offshore trips
Passport not required for some offshore trips

services.name: Charter Boats
services.desc: Deposits and Cancellation Notices - Deposits are required on all Charters. To avoid forfeiture of your deposit, a notice of cancellation is required in advance of your trip: A 90-day cancellation notice is required on all charter trips, unless otherwise noted on your receipt. We reserve the right to substitute boats

includes: Meals included in price on multi-day trips

blurb: Guests fish in local and offshore waters targeting species such as Yellowtail, Bonito, Barracuda, Calico Bass, Tuna, Dorado, and more. Trips range from half-day to multi-day charters with options for limited load and full charters. Meals, bait, permits, and some gear are included depending on the trip.
extraNote: Possible fuel surcharge depending on fuel cost on multi-day trips · Arrive 30 minutes before departure time · Fisherman's Landing, San Diego, CA
